{{Quote|Yo, Parma! How's the leg?"<br />"Workin' like new, Fenn! Ya set it just perfect!|Fenn Shysa and Parma|<ref name="SW68" />}}
'''Parma''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] freedom fighter who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. He served under [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protector]] [[Fenn Shysa]], who set his broken leg after one skirmish. Parma was present when [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited [[Mandalorian forest encampment|Shysa's forest base]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="SW68" />
